authorship: Root dot authored all scientific policies after source T7 observations; no subagent/model API scientific decisions. This is a new executable policy family, not a direct test of old prompt-W and not autonomous M self-modification.
source_evidence: Previously revealed T7 and TrpB4 trajectories; no unseen target labels or global extrema inspected.
family_holdout_interpretation: GB1/ParD/TEV are distinct from sourceT7/TrpB families; GB1/ParD were explored earlier by root and are not untouched confirmation. TEV has not been scientifically queried by root. TrpB3 transfers are within-family, not independent proteins.

excluded.DHFR: Different antibiotic-selection phenotype, transformed codon aggregate and canonical-construct caveat; reference-only in this phase. No resistance optimization.

initialization: Identical per-seed site-balanced16 parent single mutants across all arms; free supplied parent. Initial16 count in128 budget.
primary_comparison: conditional_pairwise versus additive; random is a fixed sanity baseline.
primary_metrics: best revealed valid value including supplied parent at128
secondary: top5/top10 of unique valid new sequences
aggregation: Compare within each landscape/seed; do not pool raw score units. Report wins/ties/losses and family-balanced summaries; seeds/related landscapes do not create independent proteins. No statistical significance claim from three seeds.
analysis: Report all predeclared targets, negatives, missingness and runtime failures. No changes to frozen policies or matrix after empirical outcomes; any repair must preserve scientific logic and be separately versioned.
known_limits: Gated pairwise algorithm is an explicit root-designed implementation inspired by measured reversals, not proof the original learned prompt transfers.
Same main model context informed policy design; target execution is deterministic and sees only own budgeted observations.
Historical replay does not equal prospective wetlab success.
No global ranks/optima/normalization by hidden labels.
runtime: Mandatory guardedworker and bwrap/seccomp; programtools only research_python, Mdisabled, frozenpolicy, nofallback.
storage: Local raw data/trajectories; reviewed code may be committed to work/assistant-cloud; main untouched.
